name: Noise
lead: Smooth random numbers from `noise.new`: the same seed gives the same numbers every time.

functions.name: get
functions.signature: noise:get(x: number, y_or_z: number, z: number ?) → number
functions.description: Returns about -1..1 at a point: `get(x, z)` for a height map, `get(x, y, z)` for caves and overhangs.

functions.name: grid
functions.signature: noise:grid(x: number, z: number, width: number, depth: number) → { number }
functions.description: Returns `width * depth` heights in one call, row by row: the number for `(x + dx, z + dz)` is at `[dz * width + dx + 1]`.
